title: Semantics of Clearing a Register
statement: Let $A$ be a nondeterministic register machine, with oracle, input bit string, and configuration guard $G$ fixed. Suppose that at control state $l$ the instruction clears register $r$ and proceeds to $l'$. If the configuration at $l$ satisfies $G$, and the successor configuration at $l'$ with register $r$ set to zero satisfies the termination and acceptance semantics for proposition $P$, then the configuration at $l$ satisfies those same semantics for $P$.
hypotheses_covered: The instruction at $l$ clears register $r$ and proceeds to $l'$
The cleared-register successor has the stated semantics for $P$
